name: PikuDAO USP
oneLiner: USP is PikuDAO's NAV-appreciating yield-fund token backed by Turkey-FX delta-neutral arbitrage, DeFi allocations, and a stablecoin buffer, KYC-gated.
collateral: Diversified basket of off-chain and on-chain yield strategies: BMMF Turkey FX arbitrage (delta-neutral), DeFi protocol allocations (Ethena, Aave, Cap, Giza, Almanak, USD.AI), and cash stablecoins (USDC/USDT) as a buffer; allocation governed by PikuDAO
pegMechanism: NAV-appreciating: starts at $1.00 backing; 90% of strategy yield flows back into backing pool, increasing token value over time; redemptions processed via FIFO smart-contract queue (0.2% fee, settled within 24 hours) with KYC/KYB required for minting and redeeming

oracleRisk.summary: USP's Funding Manager reads Piku's Oracle Module at 0x433471901bA1A8BDE764E8421790C7D9bAB33552. Its verified implementation exposes authorized functions to set issuance and redemption prices, and Piku describes it as a manual price feed. A live Chainlink-compatible adapter at 0xb52eb13139905eb11c472100a1e86cb1961b8ef3 returned the same price at the reviewed block, but Piku does not disclose an independent source, cadence, or enforced failover; a separate documented adapter address reverted on standard reads.

branchApplicability.rationale: USP is an issuer-operated, KYC-gated NAV product with a centralized issuance and redemption workflow, not a permissionless CDP with borrower collateral and liquidation branches.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit Yes retained: reviewed metadata indicates a direct issuer, admin, proxy, pause, burn, or upgrade control surface beyond reserve-only exposure.

mintAuthority.summary: USP is an upgradeable issuance token with owner-managed allowedMinters. The token owner is a confirmed EOA (0x3D7DBEC2…). The only active minter is the Piku Funding Manager contract and cap = max uint256. The token ProxyAdmin is controlled by a 2/3 Safe; the Funding Manager and Oracle workflow modules resolve through a separate root InverterBeacon controlled by a 1/1 Safe.

controls.label: Piku Funding Manager
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25294782: allowedMinters(0x7e0305B212dF3FB56366251C054c07748Bf9a797) = true. Checked owner EOA and ProxyAdmin Safe — neither is in allowedMinters. Zero token logs found (no additional SetMinter events). Only active direct minter confirmed.

controls.label: USP token owner EOA
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25294782: USP.owner() = 0x3D7DBEC2f6bEe780f6c5Dad61a7a905239e9E61a (confirmed EOA in prior reads). cap() = max uint256 (effectively uncapped). ProxyAdmin 0x45540a475a66674566fa9a3c5d4d7e6214b739de owner = Safe 0xc9996a03d7979003b65ae76c1154792bc24bce43 (3 owners, threshold 2, GnosisSafe v1.4.1, no modules).

controls.label: USP token ProxyAdmin Safe (2/3)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25534495, the USP token EIP-1967 implementation is 0x9e40b6be5affc984f36cf118c778f0a83be20370 and its admin is ProxyAdmin 0x45540a475a66674566fa9a3c5d4d7e6214b739de. ProxyAdmin.owner() is Safe 0xc9996a03d7979003B65aE76c1154792bc24bcE43; getThreshold() = 2, getOwners() returns three signers, VERSION() = 1.4.1, and getModulesPaginated() returns an empty list. A ProxyAdmin upgrade can replace the token implementation and alter mint logic.

controls.label: USP workflow root-beacon owner Safe (1/1)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25534495, the Funding Manager, Authorizer, Payment Processor, and Oracle Module proxy bytecode each resolves through a distinct module beacon whose owner() is 0x0B7c73e778d04533286752BEb7d4BA42AEa2f57D. That owner proxy delegates through root InverterBeacon 0xcbe9560f6584f859330275d49014624fe5341bfd, whose owner() is this Safe and whose verified implementation exposes upgradeTo. The Safe has one signer and threshold one; replacing the root implementation can change the owner behavior that governs the mint and oracle workflow beacons.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25534495: USP.owner() remains EOA 0x3D7DBEC2f6bEe780f6c5Dad61a7a905239e9E61a, Funding Manager 0x7e0305B212dF3FB56366251C054c07748Bf9a797 remains an allowed minter, and cap() remains max uint256. The token proxy is controlled through ProxyAdmin Safe 0xc9996a03d7979003B65aE76c1154792bc24bcE43 (2/3). The mint and manual-price workflow module beacons are governed through an owner proxy that resolves via root InverterBeacon 0xcbe9560f6584f859330275d49014624fe5341bfd, owned by Safe 0x945349AE62630bFDa197a4601883F4F7CBB07Fb5 (1/1). All currently observed mint-critical upgrade paths are recorded.

reserves.name: Piku reserve-strategy envelope
reserves.issuerOrObligor: PikuDAO, Balsa Technologies, and third-party DeFi strategy counterparties

sources.label: Stablewatch Piku USP analysis (secondary current-deployment table, not issuer attestation)

reserveReview.rationale: Write-time re-open 2026-08-08: Piku docs still describe USP backing as BMMF Turkey FX arbitrage, carry trades, on-chain yield and RWAs, but publish no dated primary-source allocation table or holdings snapshot. Stablewatch's secondary research (published 2025-10-15, modified 2026-03-11) includes a current-deployment table stating BMMF Turkey FX Arbitrage 50%, Giza Arma Agent 10%, Almanak Autonomous Liquidity USD 10%, USD.AI sUSDai 10%, Ethena USDe & sUSDe 10%, Aave aUSDT 5%, and cash stablecoins 0%; the article also says 40% is spread over six DeFi protocols. Because this is a third-party analysis, not an issuer attestation, and is at least 150 days old as of this review, the envelope is kept as 100% strategy other with knownUnknownExposurePct=100 rather than adopting the secondary split as reviewed fact.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Issuer strategy-category documentation plus Stablewatch secondary current-deployment table; no issuer-published dated weights or holdings snapshot
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Current strategy weights, off-chain positions and venues, DeFi protocol weights, RWA holdings, stablecoin-buffer weights, and custody balances are not published in a dated primary-source snapshot.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: Issuer materials describe the strategy categories but publish no current component weights, so the aggregate cannot be split or dependency-linked without fabrication.

custodyProfile.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-1 (lead usde-ethena)
custodyProfile.uncertainty: Piku publishes no custodian identities, account structures, or insolvency terms for either the off-chain BMMF leg or the on-chain DeFi allocations. Reserve deployment into third-party strategies is the disclosed design; whether any independent custodian holds assets is not documented.

yieldConfig.yieldSource: Turkey-FX delta-neutral arbitrage (BMMF) plus DeFi protocol allocations
